name: New Hampshire Veterinary Diagnostic Laboratory
use: State veterinary diagnostic lab run by UNH/COLSA: necropsy, pathology, serology, microbiology, molecular diagnostics
builtText: Groundbreaking spring 2015; completion expected that August
architect: Port City Architecture (design-build with AlliedCook Construction)

facts.text: The one-story, 6,500 sq ft lab was designed by Port City Architecture and built by AlliedCook Construction as design-build, with lab programming by Jacobs Consultancy.
It houses necropsy, serology, microbiology, histology and molecular diagnostics labs, plus offices, reception and a conference room, with improved climate control and ventilation over the old lab.
It was designed to fit the rural character of the agricultural campus, near the Macfarlane Greenhouses at Main Street and North Drive.
Its address is 21 Botanical Lane, Durham.
Kendall Hall was partly funded through the N.H. Department of Agriculture for the Veterinary Diagnostic Laboratory, the lab's earlier home.

verdict: Compact 2015 one-storey state diagnostic lab near the greenhouses; new and fit for purpose, little to look at.
notes: Opening year 2015 is inferred from the groundbreaking article's 'completion expected in August'. I didn't find an opening announcement. Not on notunh's map by this name. No licensed or reference photo found. The review entry is self-selected marketing testimonial, so weight it lightly.
